goal: the scenario «The Derelict (Sandy Petersen concept, Chaosium, 2016, Free RPG Day)» playable from the base, a work of the English series (Р-251)
extra:
## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `the-derelict-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show the-derelict-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image the-derelict-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report the offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- Page numbers: printed = physical − 1 (offset −1); physical 1 = cover, 50 = back cover. Pages 25–48 (printed) are the six pre-generated investigator sheets (image pages; read the page images). The owner also has the pregens as separate fillable PDFs (sheet + background with «The Derelict Agenda») in `C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\1_Библиотека\Сценарии\the.derelict.pregen.characters\Прегены\` — read their form fields (pypdf `get_fields` / `get_form_text_fields`, run Python with `-I`) for the backgrounds and agendas; they are part of this work (role `pregen`, all stats, skills, backstory, agenda). Give them `sources` on the book pages; mention the separate files in `quality.notes` without local paths.
- Ships: the yacht «Delilah» and the reefer «Groenland Tropisch» are book places; every deck plan is a `map` record with a spot on every printed label; every room of the ship described in the text — a place `part_of` its deck/level. The sciapod is a unique creature of this book (no shared record exists; Grep `kb/creatures` to be sure). Era `modern`.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-derelict` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids `the-derelict-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/the-derelict-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261116-derelict/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261116-derelict/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `derelict-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books the-derelict-en --out checks/20261116-derelict/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books the-derelict-en --out checks/20261116-derelict/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/the-derelict-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261116-derelict/derelict.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).
